title: Do independent directors enhance target shareholder wealth during tender offers?

rival_explanations: omitted firm-quality / performance effect (better managers form more-outsider boards, or poor performers add outsiders)

context.industry_setting: cross-industry (industrial firms; utilities excluded because affected by regulation and not comparable to takeovers of industrial firms)
context.country_region: United States (targets traded on the NYSE, AMEX, or NASDAQ)

data_sources.name: Wall Street Journal (WSJ) via Dow Jones News Retrieval database of WSJ abstracts
